slower.$description: Drawers and page-level panels only. Nothing inside a component runs longer than slow (300ms).

move.$description: Movement inside a control: switch thumb, tab indicator, chevron rotate. 0ms under reduced motion, so the part jumps.

sm.$description: Enter offset for small overlays: tooltip, menu, popover.

md.$description: Enter offset for toasts and other larger surfaces.

lift.$description: How far an interactive card or button rises on hover.

enter.$description: Starting scale for a modal entering. Never smaller.

press.$description: Scale of a pressed button. Releases with the spring easing.

pop.$description: Starting scale for a tick or dot popping in (checkbox, radio). Settles with the spring easing.

spring.$description: A small overshoot for things that settle: switch thumb, checkbox tick, a pressed button letting go. Never for fades or large surfaces.
